claim.breaking_section:
None. The new constructor parameter is optional and defaults to empty, and the
gateway behaves exactly as before when it is not supplied.

cover.explanation: This is a fix covered by the base-branch contract, not a new capability. docs/guide/configuration/custom-models.md promises that an alias resolves 'in any API request' without qualifying which surfaces count, and POST /mcp is an API request whose tools already accept a `model` argument; making the gateway honor that promise for lemonade_chat, lemonade_transcribe_audio, lemonade_generate_image, and lemonade_omni is delivering documented behavior. The facts pass confirms the old path failed (was: failing) and the issue's quote of line 341 matches main, so no RFC or charter is required.

surfaces.by: docs/guide/configuration/custom-models.md:341 on main: 'When an alias is specified in any API request (e.g., `/v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/embeddings`, `/v1/load`) or CLI command, Lemonade resolves the alias to its underlying target model ID'; the base-branch MCP tools already take a `model` argument (facts pass: was: failing, symbols already present in base-branch source), so issue #3434 documenting the 'Model not found' deviation is sufficient evidence

explanation.body: The title, body, and template claims describe what the diff does.
explanation.diff: The diff injects an optional ResolveAliasFn callback into McpServer (mcp_server.h/.cpp), wires it to Server::resolve_alias_target at the single construction site in server.cpp, and applies it in the explicit-model-argument branch of resolve_model_for_tool plus the inline equivalent in tool_omni, so MCP tool calls resolve aliases the way the REST endpoints do. It adds one test (test_031_chat_tool_resolves_a_model_alias) in test/server_mcp.py; no new routes, tools, flags, or config appear, and the lead flagging lemonade_chat as a possibly new tool is a false positive — it is an existing tool the test merely calls. The body matches the diff on every checkable point, including the scope list, the passthrough default for non-alias names, and the untouched Anthropic path.
explanation.quality: Checked docs/guide/configuration/custom-models.md, which already documents that an alias resolves in any API request, and docs/api/mcp.md, which makes no claim the fix contradicts — the change makes the existing wording true for MCP, so no doc edit is owed. The new numbered regression test_031_chat_tool_resolves_a_model_alias lives in test/server_mcp.py, the suite testing.md assigns to the MCP gateway, and is run by the 'Test mcp' step in cpp_server_build_test_release.yml (plus the mcp-smoke-test.yml path filter). It asserts isError is false, which fails on pre-fix code where the unresolved alias returns 'Model not found', and it cleans up the alias via addCleanup.
